agent_notes: Government identity is established from the supplied NIRF 2025 Management listing: Indian Institute of Forest Management, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain error for expected public hosts; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF and iifm.ac.in hosts.

The official Academics menu and sitemap expose the main MBA, Ph.D. FRI, Certificate Course on Chartered Foresters, and DPM pages. A separate official Quantitative Finance certificate page is linked from a homepage announcement but is absent from the Academics menu and sitemap and exposes only a brochure link, so the official catalogue is not demonstrably complete; manual_review is required.

The official Training Programme page describes short-term Management Development Programmes, seminars, workshops, and other training activities; these were excluded as short-term events rather than imported as degree, diploma, certificate, or doctoral programmes.
Legacy PGDFM and PGDSM references on the MBA pages are explicitly described as earlier names and were not imported as separate current diploma programmes.
No non-official aggregator, social profile, Wikipedia page, or search snippet was used as verification evidence.
